result.topic_en: On the arithmetic-geometric mean: its homogeneity property M(na,nb)=nM(a,b), and the beginning of a power-series expansion of M(1+x,1) in powers of x.
result.transcription:
8
4. Habeantur praeter progressiones
$\ldots{}'''a, {}''a, {}'a, a, a', a'', a'''\ldots$
$\ldots{}'''b, {}''b, {}'b, b, b', b'', b'''\ldots$
duae aliae
$\ldots{}'''c, {}''c, {}'c, c, c', c'', c'''\ldots$
$\ldots{}'''d, {}''d, {}'d, d, d', d'', d'''\ldots$
simili modo formatae; supponamusque, duos terminos in posterioribus duobus in prioribus proportionales esse, e.g. $a:b = c:d$, siue $a:c = b:d = 1:n$. Tunc omnes termini in I ad terminos in III, omnesque in II ad terminos in IV (similiter relatiue ad a, b, c, d siti ac sitos) in eadem ratione erunt, puta $c' = na'$, $c'' = na''$, $c''' = na'''$, ${}'c = n{}'a$, $d^{v} = n[-b-]b^{v}$, ${}^{v}d = {}^{v}bn$. Hinc facile deducitur, etiam limitem serierum I, II, fore ad limitem serierum III, IV vt 1 ad n, siue generaliter $M(na, nb) = nM(a,b)$. Erit itaque generaliter $M(a,b) = aM(1, \frac{b}{a}) = bM(\frac{a}{b}, 1)$.

5. PROBLEMA. Exprimere medium arithmetico geometricum inter numerum vnitate maiorem $1+x$ et vnitatem, per seriem secundum potestates ipsius $x$ progredientem.

Sol. Quum $M(1,1) = 1$, supponamus $M(1+x, 1) = 1 + h'x + h''x^2 + h'''x^3 + h^{iv}x^4 + \text{etc.}$, ita vt $h', h'', h''', h^{iv}$ sint coëfficientes constantes ab $x$ non pendentes. Sit $x = 2t + tt$, eritque $M(1+x, 1) = M(1+t+\frac{1}{2}tt, 1+t) = (1+t)M(1+\frac{\frac{1}{2}tt}{1+t}, 1)$. Quare habebitur

$1 + h'(2t+tt) + h''(2t+tt)^2 + h'''(2t+tt)^3 + \text{etc.} =$
$1 + t + h'(\frac{1}{2}tt) + h''\frac{\frac{1}{4}t^4}{1+t} + h'''\frac{\frac{1}{8}t^6}{(1+t)^2} + \text{etc.}$

methods.what: If the starting values of two AGM sequence pairs are proportional, all corresponding terms are proportional.
methods.quote: Tunc omnes termini in I ad terminos in III, omnesque in II ad terminos in IV (similiter relatiue ad a, b, c, d siti ac sitos) in eadem ratione erunt, puta $c' = na'$, $c'' = na''$, $c''' = na'''$

methods.what: Normalization of the AGM to one argument equal to 1
Substitution x=2t+t^2 and one AGM step, giving a functional equation for the coefficients
Resulting identity of series in t used to determine the coefficients h

items.quote: 5. PROBLEMA. Exprimere medium arithmetico geometricum inter numerum vnitate maiorem $1+x$ et vnitatem, per seriem secundum potestates ipsius $x$ progredientem.
items.english: 5. PROBLEM. To express the arithmetic-geometric mean between a number greater than unity, 1+x, and unity, by a series progressing in powers of x.

items.quote: Hinc facile deducitur, etiam limitem serierum I, II, fore ad limitem serierum III, IV vt 1 ad n, siue generaliter $M(na, nb) = nM(a,b)$.
items.english: Hence it is easily deduced that the limit of series I, II will also be to the limit of series III, IV as 1 to n, or generally M(na, nb) = nM(a,b).
